name: comp-316
blurb: Example FAQ dialog with styled custom scrollbar for scrollable content.
description: A premade dialog template showing how to use ScrollArea for a themed scrollbar instead of native browser scrolling.
use_when: Building FAQ or content dialogs with custom-styled scrollbars that match your theme.
avoid_when: When native scrollbars are acceptable — this adds styling overhead.
a11y: Uses Dialog and ScrollArea primitives for accessibility.
